Workstation with an Intel client processor and three discrete GPUs on current drivers: an AMD card whose amdgpu hwmon has power1_average and power1_input labeled PPT (drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/amdgpu_pm.c), an Intel card on xe with the card and pkg energy counters of Linux 6.10 and later (drivers/gpu/drm/xe/xe_hwmon.c), and an Intel card on i915 with the device counter and one per-GT counter (drivers/gpu/drm/i915/i915_hwmon.c). Values are arbitrary.
